artifact.summary: Abstained: the specification does not define generalized extreme channels, the nonlinear coupled equations, or the per-channel circuit construction. Any circuit would rest on invented structure, and a random mixture of channels cannot be written as one unitary, measurement-free circuit without inventing a mechanism for the randomness.

equation_mapping.explanation: The convex decomposition needs the definition of generalized extreme channels and the classical optimization that produces the weights p_k and channels E_k. Neither is given, so the decomposition cannot be implemented faithfully.

The diamond-norm tolerance is a classical accuracy criterion on the decomposition. It is not a gate-level operation, and checking it would require simulation or verification, which is excluded from the generated module.

Sampling circuit k with probability p_k needs classical randomness and a dynamic or externally chosen circuit. It also needs the unspecified circuits for each E_k. A single unitary build_circuit cannot realize this without invented structure.
This is the standard definition of the diamond norm. It is background for the error criterion and has no circuit counterpart.

specification_changes.change: No implementation was produced. The scope was narrowed from the convex-decomposition and random-sampling structure to nothing.
specification_changes.reason: The definition of generalized extreme channels, the optimization equations, the per-channel circuit and the role of the classical dits are all missing. Implementing any of them would fabricate the construction instead of reconstructing it.

unresolved_issues: Definition of generalized extreme channels is not given.
The nonlinear coupled algebraic equations and the optimization procedure are not given.
The circuit for each generalized extreme channel (the system plus single ancilla qudit unitary) is not given.
The role and number of classical dits is unspecified.
It is unclear how random selection of a circuit should be represented in a single measurement-free unitary build_circuit(instance).
No instance or validation contract was supplied.
